project_context: Read-only design review of 5 key pages for incremental polish without full redesign. Audience skews 60+; accessibility and legibility are non-negotiable.

design_constraints.colors: Strictly preserve existing palette (kindred cream, sage, terracotta, gold, primary-k #0E4D52). No new hex colors.
design_constraints.typography: Preserve Playfair Display (headings) and IBM Plex Mono/Sans (body). Maintain Wayly Title Case rules.
design_constraints.boundaries: No massive redesigns, no backend changes, no new pages, no stock photo additions.

Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.problem_observed: Hover states use simple vertical translations (-translate-y-0.5), feeling slightly rigid and lacking a premium tactile 'snap'.
Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.proposed_change: Increase the hover scale slightly (e.g., scale-[1.02]) with a spring-based transition. Apply a slight horizontal translation (group-hover:translate-x-1) to the ArrowRight icon.
Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.why: Micro-interactions & Motion: Adds a tactile, polished feel that reinforces interactivity without visual clutter.

Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.problem_observed: The three large numbers (e.g., 2,847 households) load statically, missing an opportunity to emphasize scale and impact.
Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.proposed_change: Implement a staggered fade-up entrance animation using intersection observers. Animate the numbers counting up from 0 to their target value over 1-1.5 seconds.
Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.why: Motion & Rhythm: Draws attention to key trust metrics dynamically as the user scrolls down the page.

Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.where: Feature Grid ('Eight AI Tools. One Calm Dashboard.')
Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.problem_observed: The cards are uniform; interacting yields a standard lift but icons remain static, making the dense grid feel slightly monotonous.
Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.proposed_change: Add a subtle micro-interaction to the Lucide icons on hover (e.g., a slight scale pulse or 10-degree rotation) and increase card internal padding from p-5 to p-6 or p-8.
Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.why: Whitespace & Micro-interactions: Increases the 'breathing room' within each tile and adds interaction delight.

Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.problem_observed: The alternating left/right layout is solid, but the static scrolling feels standard.
Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.proposed_change: Apply a subtle parallax effect or a slight vertical scroll delay to the images relative to their text blocks, so they slide into place gracefully on scroll.
Landing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/La.why: Section Transitions & Motion: Makes the narrative flow feel more dynamic and immersive.

Pricing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Pr.problem_observed: The table is visually dense and can be difficult to scan, especially for older users.
Pricing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Pr.proposed_change: Increase vertical padding on table rows (py-2.5 to py-4). Add a subtle background hover state (e.g., hover:bg-primary-k/[0.02]) to rows to guide the user's reading line across columns.
Pricing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Pr.why: Content Density & Hierarchy: Drastically improves scanability and readability for the 60+ audience.

Pricing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Pr.problem_observed: The 'Most popular' badge on the Family tier is static; hierarchy relies solely on the background color.
Pricing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Pr.proposed_change: Add a continuous, slow shimmer effect passing over the gold badge. Slightly increase the drop shadow (shadow-2xl instead of shadow-xl) on the featured tier.
Pricing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Pr.why: Hierarchy & Motion: Gently guides the user's eye to the preferred conversion path without feeling aggressive.

Pricing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Pr.problem_observed: The three columns of features appear instantly, lacking narrative sequencing.
Pricing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Pr.proposed_change: Add a staggered slide-up fade animation for the 3 columns, triggering when the section enters the viewport.
Pricing Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Pr.why: Section Transitions: Connects the flow from the pricing tiers down into the add-on details smoothly.

About Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Abou.problem_observed: The cards feel tightly packed internally (p-6 sm:p-8) contrasting with the generous wide 12-column editorial grid around them.
About Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Abou.proposed_change: Increase internal padding to p-8 sm:p-10. Increase the spacing between paragraphs inside the cards (space-y-5 to space-y-6).
About Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Abou.why: Whitespace & Rhythm: Matches the pacing and 'breathing room' of a high-end editorial piece.

About Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Abou.where: Sticky Section Markers (Left column Roman numeral + H2)
About Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Abou.problem_observed: As users scroll through long prose sections, the sticky marker remains static and blends in, losing its wayfinding value.
About Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Abou.proposed_change: Add an intersection observer to the adjacent prose. When the section is actively crossing the middle of the viewport, subtly shift the Roman numeral's color to --uxf-gold.
About Page (/app/frontend/src/pages/Abou.why: Hierarchy & Section Transitions: Provides clear, elegant wayfinding in a long-form article.

Statement Decoder Tool (/app/frontend/sr.problem_observed: The pill toggle uses instant CSS class switching for active states, feeling abrupt.
Statement Decoder Tool (/app/frontend/sr.proposed_change: Implement an animated shared-layout sliding background indicator (e.g., using Framer Motion layoutId) that glides smoothly behind the active tab.
Statement Decoder Tool (/app/frontend/sr.why: Micro-interactions: Creates a fluid, seamless state transition expected in modern, premium SaaS tools.

Statement Decoder Tool (/app/frontend/sr.problem_observed: The results (summary, line items, anomalies) appear simultaneously once loading finishes, which can overwhelm the user with data.
Statement Decoder Tool (/app/frontend/sr.proposed_change: Implement a staggered cascade reveal: The top Summary card appears first, followed by the Line Items 150ms later, and Anomalies 150ms after that.
Statement Decoder Tool (/app/frontend/sr.why: Motion & Hierarchy: Reduces cognitive overload by guiding the user through the decoded information sequentially.

Statement Decoder Tool (/app/frontend/sr.problem_observed: The active drag state only changes the static border color and scale, lacking lively feedback.
Statement Decoder Tool (/app/frontend/sr.proposed_change: Add an animated 'marching ants' (moving dashed stroke) effect to the border when dragging a file over it, and gently pulse the central Upload icon.
Statement Decoder Tool (/app/frontend/sr.why: Motion & Micro-interactions: Provides clear, immediate, and delightful visual feedback during a core user action.

Signed-in Dashboard (/app/frontend/src/p.problem_observed: The list of anomalies is dense and the 'View' link lacks affordance as an interactive row.
Signed-in Dashboard (/app/frontend/src/p.proposed_change: Apply the 'group' class to the list item. Add a subtle hover background tint (e.g., hover:bg-[--uxf-warning-bg] or similar soft token). Make the 'View' link translate slightly right on group hover.
Signed-in Dashboard (/app/frontend/src/p.why: Micro-interactions & Hierarchy: Vastly improves clickability and interactivity for critical alerts.

Signed-in Dashboard (/app/frontend/src/p.problem_observed: The percentage progress bar width is set instantly on load, missing a chance to visualize the data calculation.
Signed-in Dashboard (/app/frontend/src/p.proposed_change: Animate the width of the inner progress bar from 0% to the target percentage over 800ms using an ease-out curve when the component mounts.
Signed-in Dashboard (/app/frontend/src/p.why: Motion: Makes the data feel 'alive' and actively calculated, reinforcing trust in the system.

Signed-in Dashboard (/app/frontend/src/p.problem_observed: The four metric cards are visually uniform and border-heavy, causing slight visual clutter.
Signed-in Dashboard (/app/frontend/src/p.proposed_change: Increase the padding (p-5 to p-6) for more air. Move the icons from the left of the overline to be right-aligned in the card header, creating a stronger diagonal reading path.
Signed-in Dashboard (/app/frontend/src/p.why: Whitespace & Rhythm: Reduces cognitive load and improves the scanning rhythm of top-level metrics.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Never replace existing UXF tokens. Only apply structural, spacing, and motion adjustments.
Prioritize accessibility over pure aesthetics: ensure contrast and readability aren't sacrificed by new animations.
